title: lmswitch
description: List and toggle local LLMs (GGUF via llama.cpp, vLLM via Docker) from per-model YAML configs. The recipes on this site are lmswitch configs.

title: murmur
description: Local, hold-to-talk voice dictation for macOS. Transcribes with whisper.cpp and types into any app, with optional LLM cleanup via Ollama.

title: SolDecode
description: Chrome extension that previews Solana transactions before you sign them: simulates against live on-chain state and shows balance changes, risk warnings and a plain-English breakdown.

title: zed-token-counter
description: Zed editor extension that shows LLM token counts as inline hints.

title: dgx-spark-rack
description: Stackable, parametric, 3D-printable desktop rack for DGX Spark, written in OpenSCAD.

title: RepoBeagle
description: Static safety scanner for GitHub repos: a GREEN / YELLOW / RED verdict with file:line evidence before you clone or install. Never runs the code; catches prompt injection, MCP tool poisoning and install-time traps, entirely offline in a sandboxed container.
